## PPO brant test

```{r}

brant_test_year <- function(yr, formula) {

  ACS_data <- get(paste0("ACS_", yr, "_1Y"))
  ACS_data <- ACS_data
  
  
  ACS_data$IncCat <- ordered(
    ACS_data$IncCat,
    levels = paste0("Inc", 1:14)
  )


  Weighted_IPUMS <- as_survey(
    ACS_data,
    id = CLUSTER,
    weights = HHWT,
    strata = STRATA,
    nest = TRUE
  )

  #==================================================
  # Ordered Logit
  #==================================================

  m1 <- svyolr(
    formula,
    design = Weighted_IPUMS
  )

  K <- length(m1$lev)
  P <- length(m1$coef)

  #==================================================
  # Influence Function
  #==================================================

  get_infl <- function(k, formula, design) {

    y <- formula[[2]]

    formula[[2]] <- bquote(
      I(as.numeric(.(y)) > .(k))
    )

    mk <- svyglm(
      formula,
      design,
      family = quasibinomial,
      influence = TRUE
    )

    list(
      coef(mk),
      attr(mk, "influence")
    )
  }

  fits <- lapply(
    1:(K - 1),
    function(k) {
      get_infl(k, formula, Weighted_IPUMS)
    }
  )

  infs <- do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(fits, "[[", 2)
  )

  combined_V <- vcov(
    svytotal(
      infs / weights(Weighted_IPUMS),
      Weighted_IPUMS
    )
  )

  coefs <- lapply(fits, "[[", 1)

  #==================================================
  # Directional Brant Test
  #==================================================

  B <- do.call(
    c,
    lapply(coefs, "[", -1)
  )

  intercept_idx <- 1 + (0:(K - 2)) * (P + 1)

  VarB <- combined_V[
    -intercept_idx,
    -intercept_idx
  ]

  D_dir <- diag(P)

  for (k in 2:(K - 1)) {
    D_dir <- rbind(
      D_dir,
      diag(P)
    )
  }

  D_dir <- cbind(
    D_dir,
    matrix(
      0,
      nrow = P * (K - 1),
      ncol = K - 2
    )
  )

  for (k in 1:(K - 2)) {

    D_dir[
      (P * k) + (1:P),
      P + k
    ] <- coefs[[k + 1]][-1]

  }

  VarBinv <- solve(VarB)

  deltahat <- solve(
    t(D_dir) %*% VarBinv %*% D_dir,
    t(D_dir) %*% VarBinv %*% B
  )

  VarDelta <- solve(
    t(D_dir) %*% VarBinv %*% D_dir
  )

  i <- P + (1:(K - 2))

  brantTest_dir <- as.numeric(
    deltahat[i] %*%
      solve(VarDelta[i, i]) %*%
      deltahat[i]
  )

  p_dir <- pchisq(
    brantTest_dir,
    df = (K - 2),
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  #==================================================
  # Standard Brant Test
  #==================================================

  D_std <- matrix(
    0,
    nrow = P * (K - 2),
    ncol = P * (K - 1)
  )

  for (k in 1:(K - 2)) {

    row_idx <- ((k - 1) * P + 1):(k * P)

    col_idx_1 <- 1:P

    col_idx_k <- (k * P + 1):((k + 1) * P)

    D_std[row_idx, col_idx_1] <- diag(P)

    D_std[row_idx, col_idx_k] <- -diag(P)

  }

  diff_B <- D_std %*% B

  Var_diff <- D_std %*% VarB %*% t(D_std)

  X2_omnibus <- as.numeric(
    t(diff_B) %*%
      solve(Var_diff) %*%
      diff_B
  )

  df_omnibus <- P * (K - 2)

  p_omnibus <- pchisq(
    X2_omnibus,
    df = df_omnibus,
    lower.tail = FALSE
  )

  #==================================================
  # Results Table
  #==================================================

  coef_names <- names(m1$coef)

  results <- data.frame(
    Test = c(
      "Omnibus (Directional)",
      "Omnibus (Standard)",
      coef_names
    ),
    Chi2 = NA,
    df = NA,
    p_value = NA
  )

  results[1, 2:4] <- c(
    brantTest_dir,
    K - 2,
    p_dir
  )

  results[2, 2:4] <- c(
    X2_omnibus,
    df_omnibus,
    p_omnibus
  )

  for (p in 1:P) {

    p_rows <- seq(
      from = p,
      to = P * (K - 2),
      by = P
    )

    D_p <- D_std[
      p_rows,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    diff_p <- D_p %*% B

    Var_p <- D_p %*% VarB %*% t(D_p)

    X2_p <- as.numeric(
      t(diff_p) %*%
        solve(Var_p) %*%
        diff_p
    )

    p_val <- pchisq(
      X2_p,
      df = K - 2,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )

    results[p + 2, 2:4] <- c(
      X2_p,
      K - 2,
      p_val
    )
  }

  results$Chi2 <- round(results$Chi2, 3)
  results$p_value <- round(results$p_value, 4)

  results$YEAR <- yr


list(
  year = yr,
  results = results,
  coefs = coefs,
  combined_V = combined_V,
  m1 = m1,
  K = K,
  P = P
)



}

## separate plotting function


plot_parallel_lines_year <- function(brant_obj) {

  year <- brant_obj$year

  coefs <- brant_obj$coefs
  combined_V <- brant_obj$combined_V
  m1 <- brant_obj$m1
  K <- brant_obj$K
  P <- brant_obj$P

  conditional_V <- lapply(
    1:(K - 1),
    function(k) {

      start_idx <- (k - 1) * (P + 1) + 2
      end_idx   <- (k - 1) * (P + 1) + P + 1

      diag(
        combined_V[
          start_idx:end_idx,
          start_idx:end_idx
        ]
      )
    }
  )

  res <- data.frame(
    variable = rep(
      names(coefs[[1]])[-1],
      each = K - 1
    ),
    cutpoint = rep(
      names(m1$zeta),
      P
    ),
    estimate = as.vector(
      do.call(rbind, coefs)[, -1]
    ),
    se = sqrt(
      do.call(c, conditional_V)
    )
  )

  res$cutpoint <- factor(
    res$cutpoint,
    levels = rev(names(m1$zeta)),
    ordered = TRUE
  )

  res$lower <- res$estimate - 1.96 * res$se
  res$upper <- res$estimate + 1.96 * res$se

  ggplot(
    res,
    aes(
      y = cutpoint,
      colour = cutpoint
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(x = estimate)
    ) +
    geom_linerange(
      aes(
        xmin = lower,
        xmax = upper
      )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ variable,
      scales = "free"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Parallel Lines Diagnostic",
        year
      )
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      aes(xintercept = z),
      linetype = "dotted",
      data = data.frame(
        z = m1$coef,
        variable = names(coefs[[1]])[-1]
      )
    )
}

brant_2024 <- brant_test_year(
  2024,
  formula = formula
)

 

brant_results <- setNames(
  lapply(
    years,
    brant_test_year,
    formula = formula
  ),
  years
)

brant_plots <- lapply(
  brant_results,
  plot_parallel_lines_year
)

brant_tables <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    brant_results,
    function(x) x$results
  )
)

print(brant_tables)

for (yr in names(brant_plots)) {

  print(
    brant_plots[[yr]]
  )

}

```



# Rerunning all models with the alternative specification

```{r}

# modify this lookup table for the PPO models after running the brant tests
ppo_specs <- list(
  "2019" = FALSE ~ 1+HHSize + ChildPresent + SeniorPresent + AGE + LF + HHSize*ChildPresent,
  "2024" = FALSE ~ 1+SEX
)



fit_models_year <- function(
  yr,
  x_vector,
  ACS_means,
  ppo_specs
  ) 
  {
  ACS_data <- get(paste0("ACS_", yr, "_1Y"))

  # select the row corresponding to the year
  means_data <- ACS_means %>%
    filter(YEAR == yr)

  Weighted_IPUMS <- as_survey(
    ACS_data,
    id = CLUSTER,
    weights = HHWT,
    strata = STRATA,
    nest = TRUE
  )

  y_vector <- names(
    ACS_data %>%
      select(num_range("Inc", 1:14))
  )

  # ==================================================
  # Binary logit models
  # ==================================================

  logit_models <- lapply(y_vector, function(y) {

    logit_formula <- reformulate(
      termlabels = x_vector,
      response = y
    )

    svyglm(
      logit_formula,
      design = Weighted_IPUMS,
      family = quasibinomial(link = "logit")
    )
  })

  names(logit_models) <- y_vector

  logit_pred_matrix <- sapply(
    logit_models,
    predict,
    newdata = means_data,
    type = "response"
  )

  logit_predictions <- as.data.frame(logit_pred_matrix) %>%
    mutate(YEAR = yr) %>%
    relocate(YEAR)

  # ==================================================
  # Multinomial Logit
  # ==================================================

  mlogit_model <- svy_vglm(
    as.formula(paste("IncCat ~", x_vector)),
    design = Weighted_IPUMS,
    family = multinomial(refLevel = "Inc1")
  )

  mlogit_predictions <- predict(
    mlogit_model,
    newdata = means_data,
    type = "response"
  )

  ordered_cols <- stringr::str_sort(
    colnames(mlogit_predictions),
    numeric = TRUE
  )

  mlogit_predictions <- mlogit_predictions[
    ,
    ordered_cols,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  mlogit_predictions <- as.data.frame(
    mlogit_predictions
  ) %>%
    mutate(YEAR = yr) %>%
    relocate(YEAR)

  # ==================================================
  # Bespoke Model
  # ==================================================

  sig_coeffs_list <- purrr::map(
    logit_models,
    ~ broom::tidy(.x) %>%
      filter(
        p.value < 0.05,
        term != "(Intercept)"
      )
  )

  bespoke_models <- purrr::map2(
    logit_models,
    sig_coeffs_list,
    ~ {

      sig_terms <- .y$term

      if (length(sig_terms) == 0) {
        return(.x)
      }

      response_var <- all.vars(formula(.x))[1]

      update(
        .x,
        formula = reformulate(
          sig_terms,
          response = response_var
        )
      )
    }
  )

  names(bespoke_models) <- y_vector

  bespoke_pred_matrix <- sapply(
    bespoke_models,
    predict,
    newdata = means_data,
    type = "response"
  )

  bespoke_predictions <- as.data.frame(
    bespoke_pred_matrix
  ) %>%
    mutate(YEAR = yr) %>%
    relocate(YEAR)
  
  # ==================================================
  # PPO Model
  # ==================================================

  parallel_spec <- ppo_specs[[as.character(yr)]]

  if (!is.null(parallel_spec)) {

    ppo_formula <- as.formula(
      paste("IncCat ~", x_vector)
    )

    ppo_model <- svy_vglm(
      formula = ppo_formula,
      family = cumulative(
        link = "logitlink",
        parallel = parallel_spec
      ),
      design = Weighted_IPUMS
    )

    ppo_predictions <- predict(
      ppo_model,
      newdata = means_data,
      type = "response"
    )

    ordered_cols <- stringr::str_sort(
      colnames(ppo_predictions),
      numeric = TRUE
    )

    ppo_predictions <- ppo_predictions[
      ,
      ordered_cols,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    ppo_predictions <- as.data.frame(
      ppo_predictions
    ) %>%
      mutate(YEAR = yr) %>%
      relocate(YEAR)

    ppo_note <- NULL

  } else {

    ppo_model <- NULL
    ppo_predictions <- NULL

    ppo_note <- paste(
      "No PPO model specified for year",
      yr
    )

    message(ppo_note)

  }

  
  list(
    year = yr,

    logit_models = logit_models,
    mlogit_model = mlogit_model,
    bespoke_models = bespoke_models,
    ppo_model = ppo_model,

    logit_predictions = logit_predictions,
    mlogit_predictions = mlogit_predictions,
    bespoke_predictions = bespoke_predictions,
    ppo_predictions = ppo_predictions,

    ppo_note = ppo_note
  )


}

years <- c(2019, 2024)

model_results <- setNames(
  lapply(
    years,
    fit_models_year,
    x_vector = x_vector,
    ACS_means = ACS_means,
    ppo_specs = ppo_specs
  ),
  years
)


```
